title: 'Radical Left Lunatic' judge Trump wanted impeached takes up Ilhan Omar warrant fight
summary: Judge James Boasberg, a frequent Trump legal foe, now oversees the fight to unseal the FBI search warrant used in the raid on Rep. Ilhan Omar's home.

title: Federal judge who oversaw Maduro, Trump cases dead at 92
summary: Judge Alvin Hellerstein, who denied Cilia Flores' bond request and oversaw the Nicolas Maduro torture case, died at age 92 of natural causes.

title: Murkowski snubs Trump-backed Alaska candidate, endorses Democrat for governor
summary: GOP Sen. Lisa Murkowski of Alaska endorses Democratic gubernatorial candidate Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins for governor, despite President Trump's endorsement of a Republican candidate.

title: Long-running embassy fight comes back to haunt Trump as State Dept hit with $461M lawsuit
summary: B.L. Harbert International alleges the State Department reached a $370 million settlement over COVID-19 embassy construction claims, then reversed course.

title: Trump revisits 10-year warning to Macron as protests sweep France: ‘You have to get them out’
summary: Donald Trump told Emmanuel Macron for a decade that France would "lose" its country without addressing the immigration crisis fueling protests.

title: Trump's unusual legal gambit against Biden-era deportation rule pays off at Supreme Court
summary: The Supreme Court allowed a Texas-DOJ agreement ending the Biden-era administrative closure rule that let judges delay deportation proceedings.

title: Garrett Wilson doesn't want to be traded – but he admitted he's sick of losing with Jets
summary: Garrett Wilson said he loves the New York Jets, but admitted winning matters more as the Indianapolis Colts kick off NFL trade deadline sales.

title: Big 12 Conference addresses offensive chants from UCF fans directed at BYU during upset win
summary: The UCF Knights face a $100,000 Big 12 fine after video captured fans chanting a discriminatory phrase about Mormons before the BYU Cougars game.

title: Jon Lovitz reacts to Crystal Hefner's label as Playboy's 'No. 1 customer'
summary: Jon Lovitz responded with humor after Crystal Hefner called the comedian Playboy's "No. 1customer" on the "Lisa Guerrero Unleashed" podcast.

title: Dem strategist shrugs off Alaska ballot scandal on MS NOW, insists 'this stuff happens all the time'
summary: Democratic strategist Adrienne Elrod dismissed the Alaska ballot scandal, comparing it to Republican donors propping up RFK Jr. against Joe Biden in 2024.
